mapper.select: SELECT T.memberid, T.method, DATE_FORMAT(T.regdate, '%H:%i') regdate FROM ( SELECT * FROM ttokssaemdb.attendance WHERE (memberid, regdate) IN ( SELECT memberid, max(regdate) as regdate FROM attendance WHERE branchid = #{session_branchid} AND regdate > STR_TO_DATE(#{lastdate}, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') GROUP BY memberid ) ) T, ttokssaemdb.member M WHERE T.memberid = M.memberid AND M.classyn = 'Y'

SELECT memberid, method, hour, minute, status FROM ttokssaemdb.runtimeplan WHERE branchid = #{branchid} AND dayofweek = ${dayofweek} AND memberid = #{memberid} AND status <> 3 ORDER BY sortorder LIMIT 2
